parameters.query: SELECT token, event_id, start_utc, end_utc, summary, zoom_join_url, zoom_meeting_id FROM coexistence.ia360_meeting_links WHERE regexp_replace(coalesce(contact_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace($1, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AND end_utc >= now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY start_utc LIMIT 10
